```{r setup}
rm(list = ls())

library(data.table)
library(fixest)
library(here)
library(knitr)

track       <- "cross-section-may2026"
tables_path <- here("tracks", track, "latex", "tables")
dir.create(tables_path, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)

# Source: tracks/cross-section-may2026/data/bank_county_2014_YYYYMMDD.rds
# Built by: tracks/cross-section-may2026/code/sample-construction/02_build_bank_county_panel_20260511.R
# Contents: 8450 (RSSDID, county_fips) cells — 80 cohort banks × within-footprint
#   counties. Columns: branches_2014, bank_dep_2014_k, openings, closures,
#   county_dep_2014_k, county_hhi_2014, deposit_share_2014, opening_intensity,
#   open_share_bc, etc.
# Source: tracks/cross-section-may2026/data/cohort_2014_YYYYMMDD.rds
# Built by: tracks/cross-section-may2026/code/sample-construction/01_build_bank_dataset_20260511.R
# Contents: bank-level covariates from Call Reports 2014-Q4.
data_dir <- here("tracks", track, "data")
bc_file   <- list.files(data_dir, pattern = "^bank_county_2014_\\d{8}\\.rds$",
                        full.names = TRUE) |> sort() |> tail(1)
bank_file <- list.files(data_dir, pattern = "^cohort_2014_\\d{8}\\.rds$",
                        full.names = TRUE) |> sort() |> tail(1)
cat("Loading: ", bc_file, "\n         ", bank_file, "\n", sep = "")

bc   <- as.data.table(readRDS(bc_file))
bank <- as.data.table(readRDS(bank_file))

# Bring in selected bank-level vars (only those informative at bank level)
bank_keep <- bank[, .(RSSDID, log_assets, roa, premises_assets,
                      loans_assets, nib_share, eff_ratio)]
dt <- merge(bc, bank_keep, by = "RSSDID", all.x = TRUE)

# State (for state FE)
dt[, state := substr(county_fips, 1, 2)]

cat("Rows: ", nrow(dt),
    " | banks: ", uniqueN(dt$RSSDID),
    " | counties: ", uniqueN(dt$county_fips),
    " | states: ", uniqueN(dt$state), "\n", sep = "")
```

```{r descriptives}
# Quick LHS distribution
cat("openings  -> mean: ", round(mean(dt$openings), 2),
    " | median: ", median(dt$openings),
    " | max: ", max(dt$openings),
    " | share(==0): ", round(mean(dt$openings == 0), 3), "\n", sep = "")
cat("closures  -> mean: ", round(mean(dt$closures), 2),
    " | median: ", median(dt$closures), "\n", sep = "")
cat("opening_intensity -> mean: ", round(mean(dt$opening_intensity), 3),
    " | median: ", round(median(dt$opening_intensity), 3),
    " | p95: ", round(quantile(dt$opening_intensity, 0.95), 3), "\n", sep = "")
```

```{r setup-fixest}
setFixest_etable(
  signif.code = c("***" = 0.01, "**" = 0.05, "*" = 0.10),
  se.below    = TRUE,
  digits      = 3
)
setFixest_fml(
  ..ctr   = ~ log_county_dep + county_hhi_2014 +
              deposit_share_2014 + log_branches_2014,
  ..bctr  = ~ log_county_dep + county_hhi_2014 +
              deposit_share_2014 + log_branches_2014 +
              log_assets + roa + premises_assets
)
```

```{r models-openings-ols}
# LHS = opening_intensity (openings / branches_2014). OLS.
# Cluster by bank (RSSDID).
m1 <- feols(opening_intensity ~ ..ctr,
            data = dt, cluster = ~RSSDID)
m2 <- feols(opening_intensity ~ ..ctr | RSSDID,
            data = dt, cluster = ~RSSDID)
m3 <- feols(opening_intensity ~ ..ctr | RSSDID + state,
            data = dt, cluster = ~RSSDID)

ols_list <- list(m1, m2, m3)
```

```{r models-openings-poisson}
# LHS = openings (count). Poisson with log(branches_2014) offset
# => coefficients = elasticity of opening rate w.r.t. RHS.
p1 <- fepois(openings ~ ..ctr,
             offset = ~log(branches_2014), data = dt, cluster = ~RSSDID)
p2 <- fepois(openings ~ ..ctr | RSSDID,
             offset = ~log(branches_2014), data = dt, cluster = ~RSSDID)
p3 <- fepois(openings ~ ..ctr | RSSDID + state,
             offset = ~log(branches_2014), data = dt, cluster = ~RSSDID)

pois_list <- list(p1, p2, p3)
```

```{r main-etable}
all_list <- c(ols_list, pois_list)

mean_lhs_ols  <- round(mean(dt$opening_intensity), 4)
mean_lhs_pois <- round(mean(dt$openings),          3)

dict <- c(
  log_county_dep      = "log(County Deposits)",
  county_hhi_2014     = "County Deposit HHI",
  deposit_share_2014  = "Bank's Deposit Share in County",
  log_branches_2014   = "log(Bank Branches in County, 2014)",
  RSSDID              = "Bank",
  state               = "State"
)

et <- etable(all_list,
             headers = c("OLS", "OLS+B", "OLS+B+S",
                         "Pois", "Pois+B", "Pois+B+S"),
             dict   = dict,
             tex    = FALSE,
             extralines = list(
               "Mean(LHS)" = c(rep(mean_lhs_ols, 3), rep(mean_lhs_pois, 3))
             ))
df <- as.data.frame(et, stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
rownames(df) <- NULL
md <- kable(df, format = "pipe", row.names = FALSE)
writeLines(as.character(md),
           file.path(tables_path, "tab_bc_main.md"))

tex_out <- etable(all_list,
                  headers = c("OLS", "OLS+B", "OLS+B+S",
                              "Pois", "Pois+B", "Pois+B+S"),
                  dict   = dict,
                  tex    = TRUE,
                  style.tex = style.tex("base"),
                  extralines = list(
                    "Mean(LHS)" = c(rep(mean_lhs_ols, 3), rep(mean_lhs_pois, 3))
                  ))
writeLines(as.character(tex_out),
           file.path(tables_path, "tab_bc_main.tex"))

cat("Wrote tab_bc_main.{md,tex}\n")
```

```{r heterogeneity}
# Bank-level characteristic interacted with market contestability proxy.
# Use Poisson + bank FE so bank main effects are absorbed; interaction picks
# up "does the bank-level edge change opening response to local concentration?".

dt[, z_log_assets       := scale(log_assets)[, 1]]
dt[, z_roa              := scale(roa)[, 1]]
dt[, z_premises_assets  := scale(premises_assets)[, 1]]
dt[, z_county_hhi       := scale(county_hhi_2014)[, 1]]

h1 <- fepois(openings ~ z_county_hhi * z_log_assets +
                        log_county_dep + deposit_share_2014 + log_branches_2014 |
              RSSDID + state,
             offset = ~log(branches_2014), data = dt, cluster = ~RSSDID)
h2 <- fepois(openings ~ z_county_hhi * z_roa +
                        log_county_dep + deposit_share_2014 + log_branches_2014 |
              RSSDID + state,
             offset = ~log(branches_2014), data = dt, cluster = ~RSSDID)
h3 <- fepois(openings ~ z_county_hhi * z_premises_assets +
                        log_county_dep + deposit_share_2014 + log_branches_2014 |
              RSSDID + state,
             offset = ~log(branches_2014), data = dt, cluster = ~RSSDID)

het_list <- list(h1, h2, h3)

et2 <- etable(het_list,
              headers = c("× log(Assets)", "× ROA", "× Premises/A"),
              dict = c(
                z_county_hhi       = "County HHI (z)",
                z_log_assets       = "log(Assets) (z)",
                z_roa              = "ROA (z)",
                z_premises_assets  = "Premises/Assets (z)",
                log_county_dep     = "log(County Deposits)",
                deposit_share_2014 = "Bank's Dep Share",
                log_branches_2014  = "log(Branches 2014)",
                RSSDID             = "Bank",
                state              = "State"
              ),
              tex = FALSE)
df2 <- as.data.frame(et2, stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
rownames(df2) <- NULL
writeLines(as.character(kable(df2, format = "pipe", row.names = FALSE)),
           file.path(tables_path, "tab_bc_heterogeneity.md"))

tex2 <- etable(het_list,
               headers = c("× log(Assets)", "× ROA", "× Premises/A"),
               dict = c(
                 z_county_hhi       = "County HHI (z)",
                 z_log_assets       = "log(Assets) (z)",
                 z_roa              = "ROA (z)",
                 z_premises_assets  = "Premises/Assets (z)",
                 log_county_dep     = "log(County Deposits)",
                 deposit_share_2014 = "Bank's Dep Share",
                 log_branches_2014  = "log(Branches 2014)",
                 RSSDID             = "Bank",
                 state              = "State"
               ),
               tex = TRUE,
               style.tex = style.tex("base"))
writeLines(as.character(tex2),
           file.path(tables_path, "tab_bc_heterogeneity.tex"))

cat("Wrote tab_bc_heterogeneity.{md,tex}\n")
```

```{r key-summary}
extract <- function(m, term) {
  s <- summary(m)$coeftable
  if (!(term %in% rownames(s))) return(c(NA, NA, NA))
  c(s[term, 1], s[term, 2], s[term, 4])
}

main_terms <- c("log_county_dep", "county_hhi_2014",
                "deposit_share_2014", "log_branches_2014")

stars <- function(p) ifelse(is.na(p), "",
                     ifelse(p < 0.01, "***",
                     ifelse(p < 0.05, "**",
                     ifelse(p < 0.10, "*", ""))))

cat("Key Poisson (Pois+B+S) coefficients:\n")
for (t in main_terms) {
  e <- extract(p3, t)
  cat(sprintf("  %-22s  beta=%7.3f  se=%6.3f  p=%5.3f %s\n",
              t, e[1], e[2], e[3], stars(e[3])))
}

cat("\nHeterogeneity tests (interaction term):\n")
for (m in list(h1 = h1, h2 = h2, h3 = h3)) {
  cf <- summary(m)$coeftable
  ix <- grep(":", rownames(cf), value = TRUE)
  for (term in ix) {
    e <- cf[term, ]
    cat(sprintf("  %-40s  beta=%7.3f  se=%6.3f  p=%5.3f %s\n",
                term, e[1], e[2], e[4], stars(e[4])))
  }
}
```
